content: 965 is a huge PR. Should I split it into smaller PRs?
For me, I have started to try to split up all my PRs to 100-200 lines (where possible) and asking folks to do the same ideally. I find that much easier to review in one sitting.
I use the stacking feature so it is still all one obvious package.
Another option is to split into multiple commits and ask reviewers to go commit by commit, but I feel stacking is better cause you can merge it piece by piece as well.
